title: Melon Music Awards quiz: past Daesang winners and show facts
description: Ten sourced questions on the Melon Music Awards: who won the grand prizes in past years, and facts about MMA2026 on November 14 and 15 at Gocheok Sky Dome.

sources.title: Kakao Entertainment newsroom: MMA2026 on Nov. 14-15 (June 9, 2026)
Melon official page: Melon Music Award info (MMA2026)
Wikipedia: Melon Music Award for Song of the Year (revision 1383792585)
Wikipedia: Melon Music Award for Album of the Year (revision 1383792579)
Wikipedia: Melon Music Award for Artist of the Year (revision 1351629018)
Wikipedia: Melon Music Awards, Record of the Year (revision 1383792591)

questions.question: Which song won Song of the Year at the 2023 Melon Music Awards?
questions.fun_fact: NewJeans won Song of the Year in 2023 with Ditto. IVE had won it a year earlier with Love Dive.

questions.question: Which album won Album of the Year at the 2024 Melon Music Awards?
questions.fun_fact: Armageddon by aespa took the 2024 Album of the Year, and aespa also won Song of the Year that year with Supernova.

questions.question: Which song won Song of the Year at the 2012 Melon Music Awards?
questions.fun_fact: Psy won Song of the Year in 2012 with Gangnam Style.

questions.question: Which artist has won Melon Music Awards Artist of the Year the most times?
questions.fun_fact: BTS holds the record with three Artist of the Year wins, in 2018, 2019 and 2020.

questions.question: Who won Record of the Year at the 2025 Melon Music Awards?
questions.fun_fact: Record of the Year is judged by a panel alone. In 2025 it went to Jennie.

questions.question: Where is MMA2026 held?
questions.fun_fact: The 18th Melon Music Awards take place at Gocheok Sky Dome in Seoul.

questions.question: MMA2026 is which edition of the Melon Music Awards, according to Kakao Entertainment?
questions.fun_fact: Kakao Entertainment calls MMA2026 the 18th Melon Music Awards, held on November 14 and 15, 2026.

questions.question: At what time in Seoul does the official Melon page list the MMA2026 shows as starting?
questions.fun_fact: The Melon page lists both nights, November 14 and 15, at 18:00 Korea time.

questions.question: Which Japanese service joined Melon and Tencent Music in the Global-K Chart that MMA2026 uses?
questions.fun_fact: The Global-K Chart combines streaming and fandom activity from Melon, Tencent Music in China and LINE MUSIC in Japan.

questions.question: Which artist's Dear Name stage did Kakao Entertainment call an iconic Melon Music Awards moment from 2017?
questions.fun_fact: Kakao Entertainment also cites BTS with a traditional Korean version of Idol in 2018 and Jennie in 2025.

notes: Facts read on 2026-11-09. Past winners from Wikipedia revisions linked in the sources, show facts from the Kakao newsroom and the Melon page.
